title.zh: 通过模版ID调用通义晓蜜CCAI-对话分析AIO应用
title.en: Call a tongyi xiaomi CCAI conversation analysis AIO application by template ID

descriptions.zh:
请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解通义晓蜜CCAI-对话分析AIO产品的收费方式和价格。

前提条件
1. 已开通通义晓蜜CCAI-对话分析AIO服务。
2. 已创建应用：应用中心完成通义晓蜜CCAI-对话分析AIO应用创建，并获取到APP-ID和WORKSPACE-ID：[获取APP-ID和WORKSPACE-ID](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2782167.html?spm=a2c4g.2782164.0.0.2b2b6dcdZZ5oUE)。
descriptions.en:
Before using this operation, make sure that you fully understand the billing methods and pricing of the Tongyi Xiaomi CCAI conversation analysis AIO product.

Before you begin
1. The Tongyi Xiaomi CCAI conversation analysis AIO service is activated.
2. An application is created: Create a Tongyi Xiaomi CCAI conversation analysis AIO application in the application center and obtain the APP-ID and WORKSPACE-ID. For more information, see [Obtain APP-ID and WORKSPACE-ID](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2782167.html?spm=a2c4g.2782164.0.0.2b2b6dcdZZ5oUE).
